project_info.theme: Bottle-return sorting guide for large and small Cocoon packaging
project_info.color_palette: Warm Cream, Soft Pink, Amber Orange, Forest Green, Deep Brown

main_subject.detail: A sunlit overhead still life showing two collections of used Cocoon packaging: a large white wire basket filled with full-size bottles and pouches on the left, and a white tray filled with small-size products and minis on the right, with a hand holding a pink Hau Giang lotus micellar water bottle above the basket.
main_subject.style: Lifestyle flat-lay product classification visual, warm natural sunlight, home-organizing aesthetic

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'VỎ CHAI LỚN Bao gồm tất cả sản phẩm hũ, tuýp, túi refill, các lọ tinh chất, hũ mặt nạ, thạch dưỡng bằng thủy tinh từ 30ml...' and 'VỎ CHAI NHỎ Bao gồm thỏi son, tinh chất chấm mụn và các sản phẩm dùng thử dung tích từ 50ml trở xuống.'
items: Top Left: A hand entering from the left holding a pink Cocoon Hau Giang lotus micellar water bottle in front of a wire basket.
Top Right: White floorboards with sharp botanical shadows and the upper rim of the large wire basket.
Bottom Left: Cream text card labeled 'VỎ CHAI LỚN' beneath the basket of full-size bottles, refill pouch, shampoo bottle, micellar water, and amber products.
Bottom Right: White rectangular tray containing many mini products and a cream text card labeled 'VỎ CHAI NHỎ'.
Center/Background: Warm indoor sun patches, crisp shadows, and neatly arranged Cocoon products grouped by size.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sharp cast shadows, cozy domestic warmth, glossy bottle highlights, clear sorting-guide readability

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity lifestyle flat-lay product photography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a bottle-return sorting guide. Centerpiece is a warm sunlit overhead composition with two used Cocoon package groups: a white wire basket of large-format bottles and refill pouches on the left, and a white tray of small-format minis on the right, while a hand presents a pink Hau Giang lotus micellar water bottle above the basket. Background is pale wood flooring with strong leafy shadows. Surrounding elements: cream text cards labeled 'VỎ CHAI LỚN' and 'VỎ CHAI NHỎ' with the exact Vietnamese explanatory copy, plus realistic used product assortment in each container. Technical style: high fidelity lifestyle flat-lay product photography, direct natural window sunlight, sharp cast shadows and glossy bottle highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
